verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד זֶ֣ה ה֔וּא בֵּ֖ית יְהוָ֣ה הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְזֶה־ מִּזְבֵּ֥חַ לְעֹלָ֖ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wîḏ zeh hū bêṯ Yah·weh hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·zeh- miz·bê·aḥ lə·‘ō·lāh lə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then David said Here shall be the house of the LORD God as well as the altar of burnt offering for Israel
verses.literalPt: Disse Davi: Esta é a Casa de Deus Jeová, e este é o altar do holocausto para Israel.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד לִכְנוֹס֙ אֶת־ הַגֵּרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיַּעֲמֵ֣ד חֹֽצְבִ֗ים לַחְצוֹב֙ אַבְנֵ֣י גָזִ֔ית לִבְנ֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wîḏ liḵ·nō·ws ’eṯ- hag·gê·rîm ’ă·šer bə·’e·reṣ yiś·rā·’êl way·ya·‘ă·mêḏ ḥō·ṣə·ḇîm laḥ·ṣō·wḇ ’aḇ·nê ḡā·zîṯ liḇ·nō·wṯ bêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: So David gave orders to gather the foreigners in the land of Israel from whom he appointed stonecutters to prepare finished stones for building the house of God
verses.literalPt: Davi ordenou que se ajuntassem os estranhos que se achavam na terra de Israel; e encarregou pedreiros que preparassem pedras lavradas para se edificar a Casa de Deus.

verses.original: וּבַרְזֶ֣ל׀ לָ֠רֹב לַֽמִּסְמְרִ֞ים לְדַלְת֧וֹת הַשְּׁעָרִ֛ים וְלַֽמְחַבְּר֖וֹת הֵכִ֣ין דָּוִ֑יד וּנְחֹ֥שֶׁת לָרֹ֖ב אֵ֥ין מִשְׁקָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇar·zel lā·rōḇ lam·mis·mə·rîm lə·ḏal·ṯō·wṯ haš·šə·‘ā·rîm wə·lam·ḥab·bə·rō·wṯ hê·ḵîn dā·wîḏ ū·nə·ḥō·šeṯ lā·rōḇ ’ên miš·qāl
verses.literal: David provided a large quantity of iron to make the nails for the doors of the gateways and for the fittings together with more bronze . . . than could be weighed
verses.literalPt: Aparelhou Davi ferro em abundância para os pregos das portas e para as junturas, como também bronze em abundância e que não foi pesado;

verses.original: וַעֲצֵ֥י אֲרָזִ֖ים לְאֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר כִּֽי הֵ֠בִיאוּ הַצִּֽידֹנִ֨ים וְהַצֹּרִ֜ים עֲצֵ֧י אֲרָזִ֛ים לָרֹ֖ב לְדָוִֽיד׃פ
verses.transliteration: wa·‘ă·ṣê ’ă·rā·zîm lə·’ên mis·pār kî hê·ḇî·’ū haṣ·ṣî·ḏō·nîm wə·haṣ·ṣō·rîm ‘ă·ṣê ’ă·rā·zîm lā·rōḇ lə·ḏā·wîḏ
verses.literal: and more cedar logs than could be counted for the Sidonians and Tyrians had brought a large quantity of cedar logs to David
verses.literalPt: e madeira de cedro, inumerável; porque os sidônios e os de Tiro traziam a Davi madeira de cedro em abundância.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֗יד שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנִי֮ נַ֣עַר וָרָךְ֒ וְהַבַּ֜יִת לִבְנ֣וֹת לַיהוָ֗ה לְהַגְדִּ֨יל׀ לְמַ֜עְלָה לְשֵׁ֤ם וּלְתִפְאֶ֙רֶת֙ לְכָל־ הָ֣אֲרָצ֔וֹת אָכִ֥ינָה נָּ֖א ל֑וֹ וַיָּ֧כֶן דָּוִ֛יד לָרֹ֖ב לִפְנֵ֥י מוֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wîḏ šə·lō·mōh ḇə·nî na·‘ar wā·rāḵ wə·hab·ba·yiṯ liḇ·nō·wṯ Yah·weh lə·haḡ·dîl lə·ma‘·lāh lə·šêm ū·lə·ṯip̄·’e·reṯ lə·ḵāl hā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ ’ā·ḵî·nāh nā lōw way·yā·ḵen dā·wîḏ lā·rōḇ lip̄·nê mō·w·ṯōw
verses.literal: And David said My son Solomon is young and inexperienced and the house to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent famous and glorious throughout all lands Therefore I must make preparations for it So David made lavish preparations before his death
verses.literalPt: Disse Davi consigo: Meu filho Salomão é ainda moço e tenro, e a casa que se há de edificar para Jeová deve ser magnificentíssima, digna de fama e de glória em todos os países. Começar-lhe-ei os preparos. Assim, Davi, antes da sua morte, fez grandes preparos.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֖א לִשְׁלֹמֹ֣ה בְנ֑וֹ וַיְצַוֵּ֙הוּ֙ לִבְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā liš·lō·mōh ḇə·nōw way·ṣaw·wê·hū liḇ·nō·wṯ ba·yiṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then David called for his son Solomon and instructed him to build a house for the LORD the God of Israel
verses.literalPt: Então, chamou a seu filho Salomão e ordenou-lhe que edificasse uma casa a Jeová, Deus de Israel.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר דָּוִ֖יד לִשְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בְּנוֹ אֲנִי֙ הָיָ֣ה עִם־ לְבָבִ֔י לִבְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer dā·wîḏ liš·lō·mōh bə·nō ’ă·nî hā·yāh ‘im- lə·ḇā·ḇî liḇ·nō·wṯ ba·yiṯ lə·šêm Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāy
verses.literal: My son . . . said David to Solomon it was in my heart to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God
verses.literalPt: Disse Davi a seu filho Salomão: Quanto a mim, foi a minha intenção edificar uma casa ao nome de Jeová, meu Deus.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֨י עָלַ֤י דְּבַר־ יְהוָה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר דָּ֤ם לָרֹב֙ שָׁפַ֔כְתָּ וּמִלְחָמ֥וֹת גְּדֹל֖וֹת עָשִׂ֑יתָ לֹֽא־ תִבְנֶ֥ה בַ֙יִת֙ לִשְׁמִ֔י כִּ֚י דָּמִ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים שָׁפַ֥כְתָּ אַ֖רְצָה לְפָנָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ‘ā·lay də·ḇar- Yah·weh lê·mōr dām lā·rōḇ šā·p̄aḵ·tā ū·mil·ḥā·mō·wṯ gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ ‘ā·śî·ṯā lō- ṯiḇ·neh ḇa·yiṯ liš·mî kî dā·mîm rab·bîm šā·p̄aḵ·tā ’ar·ṣāh lə·p̄ā·nāy
verses.literal: but this word of the LORD . . . came to me You have shed much blood and waged great wars You are not to build a house for My Name because you have shed so much blood on the ground before Me
verses.literalPt: A palavra, porém, de Jeová veio a mim, dizendo: Tens derramado muito sangue e tens feito grandes guerras; não edificarás casa ao meu nome, porque tens derramado muito sangue sobre a terra, na minha presença.

verses.original: הִנֵּה־ בֵ֞ן נוֹלָ֣ד לָ֗ךְ ה֤וּא יִהְיֶה֙ אִ֣ישׁ מְנוּחָ֔ה וַהֲנִח֥וֹתִי ל֛וֹ מִכָּל־ אוֹיְבָ֖יו מִסָּבִ֑יב כִּ֤י שְׁלֹמֹה֙ יִהְיֶ֣ה שְׁמ֔וֹ וְשָׁל֥וֹם וָשֶׁ֛קֶט אֶתֵּ֥ן עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּיָמָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh- ḇên nō·w·lāḏ lāḵ hū yih·yeh ’îš mə·nū·ḥāh wa·hă·ni·ḥō·w·ṯî lōw mik·kāl ’ō·wy·ḇāw mis·sā·ḇîḇ kî šə·lō·mōh yih·yeh šə·mōw wə·šā·lō·wm wā·še·qeṭ ’et·tên ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl bə·yā·māw
verses.literal: But a son will be born to you who will be a man of rest I will give him rest . . . from all his enemies on every side for his name will be Solomon and I will grant to Israel peace and quiet during his reign
verses.literalPt: Eis que te nascerá um filho, que será homem de repouso; dar-lhe-ei repouso de todos os seus inimigos ao redor. Será chamado Salomão, e darei paz e descanso a Israel nos seus dias.

verses.original: הֽוּא־ יִבְנֶ֥ה בַ֙יִת֙ לִשְׁמִ֔י וְהוּא֙ יִהְיֶה־ לִּ֣י לְבֵ֔ן וַאֲנִי־ ל֖וֹ לְאָ֑ב וַהֲכִ֨ינוֹתִ֜י כִּסֵּ֧א מַלְכוּת֛וֹ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hū- yiḇ·neh ḇa·yiṯ liš·mî wə·hū yih·yeh- lî lə·ḇên wa·’ă·nî- lōw lə·’āḇ wa·hă·ḵî·nō·w·ṯî kis·sê mal·ḵū·ṯōw ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: He is the one who will build a house for My Name He will be My son and I will be his Father And I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever . . .
verses.literalPt: Ele edificará uma casa ao meu nome; ele será meu filho, e eu serei seu pai; estabelecerei o trono do seu reino sobre Israel, para sempre.

verses.original: עַתָּ֣ה בְנִ֔י יְהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּ֑ךְ וְהִצְלַחְתָּ֗ וּבָנִ֙יתָ֙ בֵּ֚ית יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר עָלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh ḇə·nî yə·hî Yah·weh ‘im·māḵ wə·hiṣ·laḥ·tā ū·ḇā·nî·ṯā bêṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ka·’ă·šer dib·ber ‘ā·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Now my son may the LORD be with you and may you succeed in building the house of the LORD your God as He said you would
verses.literalPt: Agora, meu filho, seja Jeová contigo; prospera e edifica a Casa de Jeová, teu Deus, como ele falou a respeito de ti.

verses.original: אַ֣ךְ יִֽתֶּן־ לְּךָ֤ יְהוָה֙ שֵׂ֣כֶל וּבִינָ֔ה וִֽיצַוְּךָ֖ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלִשְׁמ֕וֹר אֶת־ תּוֹרַ֖ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’aḵ yit·ten- lə·ḵā Yah·weh śê·ḵel ū·ḇî·nāh wî·ṣaw·wə·ḵā ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl wə·liš·mō·wr ’eṯ- tō·w·raṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: Above all may the LORD give you insight and understanding when He puts you in command over Israel so that you may keep the Law of the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Pelo menos te dê Jeová prudência e entendimento e te instrua acerca de Israel, para que assim guardes a lei de Jeová, teu Deus.

verses.original: אָ֣ז תַּצְלִ֔יחַ אִם־ תִּשְׁמ֗וֹר לַעֲשׂוֹת֙ אֶת־ הַֽחֻקִּ֣ים וְאֶת־ הַמִּשְׁפָּטִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל חֲזַ֣ק וֶאֱמָ֔ץ אַל־ תִּירָ֖א וְאַל־ תֵּחָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz taṣ·lî·aḥ ’im- tiš·mō·wr la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- ha·ḥuq·qîm wə·’eṯ- ham·miš·pā·ṭîm ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- mō·šeh ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl ḥă·zaq we·’ĕ·māṣ ’al- tî·rā wə·’al- tê·ḥāṯ
verses.literal: Then you will succeed if you carefully follow the statutes and ordinances that the LORD commanded Moses for Israel Be strong and courageous Do not be afraid . . . or discouraged
verses.literalPt: Então, serás próspero, se cuidares em cumprir os estatutos e os juízos que Jeová mandou a Moisés acerca de Israel. Esforça-te e tem bom ânimo; não tenhas medo, nem te desalentes.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֨ה בְעָנְיִ֜י הֲכִינ֣וֹתִי לְבֵית־ יְהוָ֗ה זָהָ֞ב כִּכָּרִ֤ים מֵֽאָה־ אֶ֙לֶף֙ וְכֶ֗סֶף אֶ֤לֶף אֲלָפִים֙ כִּכָּרִ֔ים וְלַנְּחֹ֤שֶׁת וְלַבַּרְזֶל֙ אֵ֣ין מִשְׁקָ֔ל כִּ֥י לָרֹ֖ב הָיָ֑ה וְעֵצִ֤ים וַאֲבָנִים֙ הֲכִינ֔וֹתִי וַעֲלֵיהֶ֖ם תּוֹסִֽיף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ḇə·‘ā·nə·yî hă·ḵî·nō·w·ṯî lə·ḇêṯ- Yah·weh zā·hāḇ kik·kā·rîm mê·’āh- ’e·lep̄ wə·ḵe·sep̄ ’e·lep̄ ’ă·lā·p̄îm kik·kā·rîm wə·lan·nə·ḥō·šeṯ wə·lab·bar·zel ’ên miš·qāl kî lā·rōḇ hā·yāh wə·‘ê·ṣîm wa·’ă·ḇā·nîm hă·ḵî·nō·w·ṯî wa·‘ă·lê·hem tō·w·sîp̄
verses.literal: Now behold I have taken great pains to provide for the house of the LORD 100,000 . . . talents of gold 1,000,000 . . . talents of silver and bronze and iron too great . . . . . . . . . to be weighed I have also provided timber and stone and you may add to them
verses.literalPt: Eis que, com duro trabalho, preparei para a Casa de Jeová cem mil talentos de ouro e um milhão de talentos de prata, e de bronze e de ferro que não se podem pesar, porque é em abundância; madeira também e pedra preparei; podes aumentá-los.

verses.original: וְעִמְּךָ֤ לָרֹב֙ עֹשֵׂ֣י מְלָאכָ֔ה חֹצְבִ֕ים וְחָרָשֵׁ֥י אֶ֖בֶן וָעֵ֑ץ וְכָל־ חָכָ֖ם בְּכָל־ מְלָאכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘im·mə·ḵā lā·rōḇ ‘ō·śê mə·lā·ḵāh ḥō·ṣə·ḇîm wə·ḥā·rā·šê ’e·ḇen wā·‘êṣ wə·ḵāl ḥā·ḵām bə·ḵāl mə·lā·ḵāh
verses.literal: You also have many workers . . . stonecutters masons . . . carpenters and men skilled . . . in every kind of work
verses.literalPt: Além disso, tens trabalhadores em abundância, pedreiros e carpinteiros; e todos os que são peritos em toda sorte de obra.

verses.original: לַזָּהָ֥ב לַכֶּ֛סֶף וְלַנְּחֹ֥שֶׁת וְלַבַּרְזֶ֖ל אֵ֣ין מִסְפָּ֑ר ק֣וּם וַעֲשֵׂ֔ה וִיהִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: laz·zā·hāḇ lak·ke·sep̄ wə·lan·nə·ḥō·šeṯ wə·lab·bar·zel ’ên mis·pār qūm wa·‘ă·śêh wî·hî Yah·weh ‘im·māḵ
verses.literal: in gold and silver bronze and iron craftsmen beyond number Now begin the work and may the LORD be with you
verses.literalPt: O ouro, a prata, o bronze e o ferro são inumeráveis. Levanta-te e mete mão à obra, e seja Jeová contigo.

verses.original: וַיְצַ֤ו דָּוִיד֙ לְכָל־ שָׂרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַעְזֹ֖ר לִשְׁלֹמֹ֥ה בְנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw dā·wîḏ lə·ḵāl śā·rê yiś·rā·’êl la‘·zōr liš·lō·mōh ḇə·nōw
verses.literal: Then David ordered all the leaders of Israel to help his son Solomon
verses.literalPt: Também Davi ordenou a todos os príncipes de Israel que ajudassem a seu filho Salomão, dizendo:

verses.original: הֲלֹ֨א יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ עִמָּכֶ֔ם וְהֵנִ֥יחַ לָכֶ֖ם מִסָּבִ֑יב כִּ֣י׀ נָתַ֣ן בְּיָדִ֗י אֵ֚ת יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וְנִכְבְּשָׁ֥ה הָאָ֛רֶץ לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה וְלִפְנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ‘im·mā·ḵem wə·hê·nî·aḥ lā·ḵem mis·sā·ḇîḇ kî nā·ṯan bə·yā·ḏî ’êṯ yō·šə·ḇê hā·’ā·reṣ wə·niḵ·bə·šāh hā·’ā·reṣ lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·lip̄·nê ‘am·mōw
verses.literal: Is not the LORD your God with you and has He not granted you rest . . . on every side For He has given the inhabitants of the land into my hand and the land has been subdued before the LORD . . . and His people
verses.literalPt: Não está convosco Jeová, vosso Deus? E não vos deu descanso por todos os lados? Entregou-me nas mãos os habitantes da terra; e a terra está subjugada diante de Jeová e diante do seu povo.

verses.original: עַתָּ֗ה תְּנ֤וּ לְבַבְכֶם֙ וְנַפְשְׁכֶ֔ם לִדְר֖וֹשׁ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֑ם וְק֗וּמוּ וּבְנוּ֙ אֶת־ מִקְדַּשׁ֙ יְהוָ֣ה הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים לְהָבִ֞יא אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֗ה וּכְלֵי֙ קֹ֣דֶשׁ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים לַבַּ֖יִת הַנִּבְנֶ֥ה לְשֵׁם־ יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh tə·nū lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem wə·nap̄·šə·ḵem liḏ·rō·wōš Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem wə·qū·mū ū·ḇə·nū ’eṯ- miq·daš Yah·weh hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·hā·ḇî ’eṯ- ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- Yah·weh ū·ḵə·lê qō·ḏeš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm lab·ba·yiṯ han·niḇ·neh lə·šêm- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Now set your heart and soul to seek the LORD your God Begin building the sanctuary of the LORD God so that you may bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD and the holy articles of God into the temple that will be built for the Name of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Disponde o vosso coração e a vossa alma para buscardes a Jeová, vosso Deus; levantai-vos e edificai o santuário de Deus Jeová, para que a arca da Aliança de Jeová e os vasos sagrados de Deus sejam trazidos para a casa que se há de edificar ao nome de Jeová.
